Chhatr aandolan sirph virodh nahin, balki loktantr aur adhikaron ki raksha ki aavaz hain. purv aaisa adhyaksh en. saeen balaji bata rahe hain ki kaise yuva alag-alag muddon par hasy, soshal midiya aur shantipurn pradarshanon ke jarie pratirodh jari rakhe hue hain.
